title: Econometrics REITInflationPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed association analysis between REIT index returns and inflation (YoY) at quarterly frequency. Implemented reproducible pipeline (code/run_analysis.py) producing cleaned panel, summary stats, HAC regressions, rolling correlations, VAR/Granger tests, and figures saved as PNGs in report/images. Fixed quarter index parsing (integer quarter counter) and VAR causality export. Generated markdown tables (code/make_tables.py) and populated final report/report.md via code/build_report.py with inserted estimates and referenced figures.
